sections.roomName: Family King Room in Rameswaram – Sleeps 4 Adults
sections.description:
Enjoy a comfortable stay in our Family King Room, designed for families and small groups visiting Rameswaram. The room features a spacious King-size mattress, comfortably accommodating up to 3 adults. With additional mattresses, the room can accommodate up to 5 adults, making it a practical option for families travelling together.
The room is air-conditioned and equipped with a table, mirror and essential guest facilities. It also includes a private bathroom with a Western-style toilet and wash basin, providing guests with convenient private accommodation.
